cost_rule: Mana = Rank, less your tier discount (Seasoned 1, Veteran 2, Heroic 3, Legendary 4), minimum 1. Paid win or lose. Effort and Effect boxes are never discounted. Basic Casts are free.

sources.name: Arcane
text: Backlash 1 heavier; Fallout outward: the GM sets an environmental consequence that escapes into the world.

Gestures, spoken words, runes and components, always visible to any bystander. It can be taught, copied and learned from writing; a witness can identify a cast with Analyze DC 12 and, with study, reproduce it. Silenced stops it unless you pass Cast DC 10; Restrained is −2. A target who is also an Arcane caster may Defend against it with Willpower, not just Deflect. Casting offers no Resolve comfort. Can be Abjured.

sources.name: Divine
text: Backlash 1 lighter; Fallout inward: you gain Removed (Spirit) for d4 hours, until the bond with your Source is repaired.

Faith Source: can’t be Defended, only Deflected (Deflect Ability, no skill). A successful cast clears 1 of your own Resolve boxes, unless used against your faith’s values. Can’t be copied, transcribed or learned by watching.

Holy symbols, prayer, laying on hands. The power is your own stored faith, not the deity’s approval for each act; a crisis of faith Drains Mana −2 until resolved. Can’t be Silenced. Native access to the Healing Effect. Authority over the Supernatural: a Divine Power aimed at an undead, demonic, spirit-touched or Void-sourced target counts as 1 Rank higher, at no extra Mana, and can reach Rank 6. Can be Abjured.

sources.name: Innate
text: Standard backlash.

No components: a bloodline, biological or cosmic gift. It can’t be taught or copied. It uses whatever Ability fits the power, chosen at creation and never changed, and the GM sets its source with you. Can’t be Abjured, only Negated by Powers made for it. Its Void Effects are not forbidden power.

sources.name: Psionic
text: Standard backlash; Fallout in the mind: mental broadcast, burnout, echo or feedback.

Silent, with no visible tell unless you choose one, so it is the only Source usable in a social scene without being noticed. Can’t be Silenced, but psionic shielding (specific Powers or TL 9+ technology) blocks it, and lead shielding blocks Telepathy. Other psionics detect its use at Acuity DC 13. Creatures with no mind may be immune to its Psychic Effects at 1–3 boxes.

sources.name: Spirit / Shamanic
text: Backlash 1 lighter; Fallout inward: you gain Removed (Spirit) for d4 hours, until the bond with your Source is repaired.

Faith Source: can’t be Defended, only Deflected (Deflect Ability, no skill). A successful cast clears 1 of your own Resolve boxes, unless used against your faith’s values. Can’t be copied, transcribed or learned by watching.

Ritual objects, offerings, spoken bargains, drumming, dance. The power is gifted by spirits, ancestors or forces of nature, not your own, so you must keep that relationship: the entity may want something in return, and can renege on the deal or improve it. Can’t be Abjured, since the spirit, not you, is casting. Its Void Effects are not forbidden power.

sources.name: Weird Science
text: Standard backlash.

TL 5+. Always a physical gadget, serum, device or formula, most needing 10 minutes to an hour of preparation out of combat. A gadget can be targeted (DR 0, 6 Stamina) and is unusable until rebuilt. Anyone with the Intellect and the materials can learn it. It has no Corruption track.

sources.name: Alchemical
text: TL 3+. Potions, bombs, salves and reagents crafted out of combat; drawing and using one is instant. Carry 3–6 per scene (the GM sets it). Activation costs Stamina, not Mana: the preparation was the hard part.

sources.name: Blood Magic
text: Spend Stamina boxes as Mana, one for one, with no Mana pool needed. Those boxes count as damage taken and can make you Hurt or Injured. Using an unwilling target’s blood is forbidden power. Often restricted or forbidden by law.

sources.name: Chi / Ki
text: No components: breath, movement and trained focus. Innate is what you were born with; Chi is what you trained for, and anyone can learn it with time. Can’t be Abjured, only disrupted by anti-ki techniques.

sources.name: Cybernetic
text: TL 8+. Implanted, always on or on demand, and can’t be dropped, stolen or targeted without surgery. An Electric Effect at 3+ boxes can short it out; an EMP disables it for the scene. Heavy implants may bring social penalties (GM).

sources.name: Demonic / Pact-Bound
sources.pools_text: Mana / Resolve (and sometimes Stamina — see notes)
text: Power from a demonic or infernal entity with a fixed agenda, through a symbol, trigger word or gesture the pact sets. The deal was bad, and the contract can’t be renegotiated. Every Pact-Bound Power is forbidden power.

sources.name: Nature / Primal
text: Touch, nearness to natural material and spoken communion, never manufactured components: a bond with the land itself, not its spirits. −1 to its rolls in urban TL 8+ settings. An Earth Effect counts 1 Rank higher against Void-sourced targets.

sources.name: Runic / Inscription
text: TL 2+. Runes, sigils and inscriptions written in advance; a rune fires for free, once, then is spent. Permanent runes etched in stone or metal cost double Mana to prepare. You can’t improvise a new effect in combat: you bring what you prepared.

sources.name: Void
text: Standard backlash.

Choose its origin at creation: Space, the empty dark between worlds, impersonal and wanting nothing; or the Old Ones, vast minds outside the world who may notice you and whom the GM may call on. No visible components: light dims and sound dulls around you. A Void Basic Cast crosses Stamina, since Void unmakes the physical. All Void power is forbidden power. The Void Effect never takes the −1 for being non-Signature. Divine Powers and Nature / Primal Earth Effects count 1 Rank higher against Void-sourced targets. It can’t be taught safely: it is learned from forbidden texts or from contact. Can be Abjured.
Void is contact with something that does not care about you. A deal with something that wants you is Demonic / Pact-Bound.

weird.source: Book of Genres, Weird Magic. Tainted is tracked as Corruption (DECISIONS.md).
weird.when: Whenever you cast a Weird Magic Power, roll d20 after the Power's success or failure is resolved. The result applies on top of the normal Power effect. A Bane (natural 1) on the cast, or a Backlash or Revelation result, adds 1 Corruption.

table.name: Backlash
table.effect: The Power also targets the caster at half effect. Add 1 Corruption immediately.

table.name: Bleed
table.effect: The Power leaves a visible mark on the caster — a scorch, a sigil, a color in the eye. Narrative only; the GM tracks it and may use it later.

table.name: Echo
table.effect: The Power fires again next round at the same target. No Action or pool cost required.

table.name: Drain
table.effect: The pool cost drains from a random pool. Roll d20: 1–7 Mana, 8–14 Stamina, 15–20 Resolve.

table.name: Effort Free
table.effect: The Power gains 1 free Effort box this cast at no cost.

table.name: Stable
table.effect: No additional effect. The Weird was quiet this time.

table.name: Shift
table.effect: The Effect type changes to an adjacent type. GM and player agree on adjacency (Fire→Electric, Psychic→Void, Toxic→Cold, etc.).

table.name: Revelation
table.effect: The caster briefly perceives something they were not meant to see. The GM narrates a fragment of forbidden knowledge. Mark 1 Resolve box. Add 1 Corruption.

weird.fallout_when: On a Weird Magic cast, a natural 1 while using Effort 3+ boxes is Weird Fallout instead of the normal Effort Fallout. Roll d20:

fallout.name: Uncontrolled outward
fallout.effect: The Power manifests in the environment (as Arcane Fallout). Add 1 Corruption.

fallout.name: Inward
fallout.effect: The caster gains Removed (Spirit) for the rest of the scene (as Spiritual Fallout). Add 1 Corruption.

fallout.name: Unravelling
fallout.effect: The Power fails completely — no effect, pool cost still paid. Add 1 Corruption.

fallout.name: Something notices
fallout.effect: The GM introduces a supernatural consequence in the next scene — an entity drawn by the signal, a shift in local reality, an uninvited presence. Add 2 Corruption.

notes: Weird Control (Willpower, DC 14): try to direct or suppress a Weird Table result before it resolves — choose between the rolled result and a re-roll. Succeeding twice on Weird Control in one scene adds 1 Corruption.
Weird Read (Acuity): after 3+ Weird rolls in a session, the GM gives insight into what the Weird is doing.
Witnesses to Weird Magic, allies included, make a Horror Check DC 12 when they see it cast. The caster is exempt.

The Weird Role changes these rolls: roll twice and choose (Step 1), Revelation marks no Resolve (Step 2), declare a result once per scene (Step 3), choose the Drain pool (Step 4), redirect Backlash to a visible target (Step 5).

making_rule: Start at Rank 1: one target, Near range or closer, instant, doing one small thing. Add +1 for each upgrade. On a hit, cross boxes equal to the overage or the Rank, whichever is higher, up to the Hit Cap.
limits_rule: Tough targets: a Power that controls or removes a foe without crossing boxes must be at least Rank 3 against a Rival, Rank 4 against an Antagonist, Rank 5 against a Boss. Minions can be affected at any Rank. Ask the GM only for story-changing magic.
cantrip_rule: A cantrip is Rank 1 on one target or yourself, with no Effort: an attack, heal or Condition at Close or Touch that crosses at least 1 box on a hit, or a utility trick up to Near (one that only senses may cover an area). Free when your Attack Ability plus Cast or Channel skill totals 3 or more, otherwise it costs normal Mana.
spell_rule: A spell’s Step N is its Rank N form. Use any Step up to your tier’s highest Rank (Novice 2, Seasoned 3, Veteran 4, Heroic 5). Its Rank is its cost, less your tier discount. On a hit, cross boxes equal to the overage or the Rank, whichever is higher.

corruption_rule: A Bane on a roll that uses forbidden power gives Corruption +1, automatically, at every tier. Forbidden power is Void power (except a Void Effect used by an Innate or Spirit / Shamanic caster), a Pact-Bound Power, Blood Magic using an unwilling target’s blood, a faith Source turned against its values, and any other overreach the GM calls. Fallout adds Corruption too: Major +1, Severe +1, Catastrophic +2. There are no Corruption checks.
